Advanced manufacturing / WAAM

Print larger.
Build smarter.

Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing for large rocket structures, developed around an initial 550 mm x 1500 mm build envelope.

View development targets ↗

Large-format metal deposition

Rocket structures
without the size limit.

WAAM deposits metal wire through a robotic welding process, making it suitable for large structural parts that exceed powder-bed build volumes.

Elara is evaluating the process for tanks, frames, and other rocket hardware where part size, material efficiency, and repairability matter.
